recentItems.title: He Couldn't Afford Gas Money — Then This Charity Saved His Broadway Career
recentItems.description: Stage Door Manor turned out Natalie Portman, Sebastian Stan, Lea Michele... and this guy. Now they're all reuniting on Broadway for one night to celebrate 50 years and give back to the fund that literally kept him afloat when he couldn't even pay for gas. Full circle moment.
